items.title: Chinese AI Researchers Are Finding Their Voice on X
items.summary: As OpenAI and Anthropic employees grow quieter online, researchers at Chinese AI labs are flocking to X to explain their work, recruit talent, and shape the global conversation on AI.
items.author: Zeyi Yang

items.title: AI Slop Melodramas Are Taking Over X—and Their Creators Are Cashing In
items.summary: Viral tales of good triumphing over evil are racking up millions of views. They’re almost entirely AI-generated clickbait.
items.author: Steven Levy

items.title: This AI Assistant Wants to Make Up for Your Boyfriend’s Incompetence
items.summary: An ad for Orchid suggests the AI agent can fix relationship problems by simply doing everything for inconsiderate partners.
items.author: Jason Parham
